text:
maria: Customer on private deployment seeing repeated 400s from /v1/invoke when calling payments_tool. Says it worked before. Escalating — possible schema validation delta.

raj: ack, can you paste the exact request + error payload?

maria: here — repro from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"tool":"payments_tool","args":{"amount":"1000","currency":"USD","line_items":[{"name":"seat","qty":1}],"debug":true,"billing_profile":{}}}'
```
and server response:
```json
{
  "error":"jsonschema_validation_failed",
  "details":[
    {"path":"/args/amount","message":"expected number but got string"},
    {"path":"/args/billing_profile","message":"required property 'id' is missing"},
    {"path":"/args","message":"additionalProperties not allowed: debug"}
  ]
}
```

maria: customer says they haven't changed payload; they upgraded SDK last week. We suspect SDK started sending debug flag and coerces numeric amounts to string for JS clients.

eng-ml-ana: thx for the dump. Two issues here: 1) required field missing (billing_profile.id) — server should reject, that's expected; 2) amount as string — we currently enforce numeric type; 3) additionalProperties for args failing because schema has additionalProperties=false.

eng-ml-ana: quick triage options:
- short term: advise customer to remove debug, ensure billing_profile.id present, and send amount as number (coerce client-side) — fastest unblock.
- medium term: add a lenient compatibility layer in gateway to coerce numeric strings to numbers and strip allowed debug flag when present for known tools. This reduces breakage from SDK patches but is a behavioral change.

kevin: I'll open an internal ticket to track the compatibility shim and risk analysis. If we add coercion we need clear tests and feature gate tied to private deployment opt-in.

sara: can we also update SDK docs and release notes to call out that amount must be numeric and billing_profile.id required? Customer-facing step first. I can draft a short KB and a sample snippet.

raj: immediate ask to support: send patch with these instructions to customer. If they can't edit, ask them to downgrade SDK to previous minor.

maria: sent remediation steps and sample corrected payload to customer. Waiting on their reply. Pasting corrected payload we recommended:
```json
{"tool":"payments_tool","args":{"amount":1000,"currency":"USD","line_items":[{"name":"seat","qty":1}],"billing_profile":{"id":"cust_123"}}}
```

support-bot: Created INC-1234 and linked to ENG-554 (compatibility-shim).

kevin: assigned ENG-554 to eng-runtime; ETA initial design doc 48h. @eng-ml-ana please include tests for additionalProperties=false behavior.

eng-ml-ana: will add unit test suite and a short-run canary for private deployments only. Also adding telemetry to see how many calls include `debug` and numeric-as-string amounts.

maria: customer replied — they patched client and request now succeeds. Marking this thread resolved from support side but leaving INC open for engineering follow-up. :thumbsup:
